title: Rezoning to allow housing at 132 Melrose Street, Brooklyn
summary: This land use application would change the zoning map at 132-136 Melrose Street in Bushwick, Brooklyn from an M1-1 manufacturing district to an M1-2A/R6A district with a Special Mixed Use District. The change would help enable a new six-story, roughly 24,600-square-foot mixed-use building with 18 apartments, including five permanently income-restricted units, plus 6,000 square feet of ground-floor commercial space.
